written: 2026-11-28, before any comparison was computed and before any LSE call for it
changes_from_v1: truth: the FIRST snapshot after d's close + 15 min, not the last: overnight Cboe reprices its frozen 1-day quotes with less time left (ES 18 Nov: 0.268 at 22:46 UTC, 0.330 at 08:30 UTC)

truth field: extras.expected_move.daily_iv (the index's own options only, call and put averaged at the strike nearest the price, time counted from Cboe's quote time), not expected_move.atm_iv, which can be a converted QQQ or SPY option
LSE rows: /v3/options/flow prints (each carries the IV of its minute), collapsed to one row per contract; the chain endpoint serves only the newest session
A's secondary comparison (one session late) is not run: the owner's budget is 20 LSE calls
pass_bar: identical to v1 pass_bar_proposed, approved by the owner on 2026-11-28 (approval.json)
privacy: as v1: LSE values and per-pair results stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%/gexsys/studies/occ_lse_accuracy/

A_iv_level.pairs: market in (NQ, ES) x session d with a Cboe-era snapshot taken after rth_close(d) + 15 min and before the next session's open, in %LOCALAPPDATA%/gexsys/snapshots/{NQ-CBOE,ES-CBOE}/; a pair without one is dropped and counted
A_iv_level.truth: the first such snapshot: IV_cboe = extras.expected_move.daily_iv, expiry E = daily_iv_expiry (it must be the session after d), price S = anchor, time t0 = variance_from
A_iv_level.vix_same: the OCC provider's curve of vol date d (_curve_on; x VXN/VIX for NDX) at T = (E's expiry time - t0) in years

smile_same.lse_call: GET /v3/options/flow underlying=NDXP (NQ) or SPXW (ES), expiry=E, strike_min=floor(0.96 S), strike_max=ceil(1.04 S), from=rth_close(d) - 60 min, to=rth_close(d) (UTC, seconds), order=desc, limit=5000; one call per pair; returned = 5000 is reported as truncated (the newest 5000 prints kept)
smile_same.rows: per contract (strike, call/put): the last print's ts as last_trade_at, its iv and underlying_price as greeks_underlying_price (a print without underlying_price takes the index's Yahoo 1-minute close of that print's minute, ^NDX or ^GSPC, chart interval=1m; with neither, the print is dropped and counted); volume_today = the sum of the window's print sizes
smile_same.fit: gexsys/smile.py rules v1 with sigma_ref = vix_same; session window = d's open to close, rows inside the last hour only (the fallback to the whole session would need another call: when the last hour fails the fit test, the pair is reported as 'no smile' and counted, never filled in)
smile_same.price: Surface({E: fit}, r, q, anchor 1).iv(E, K = S, S, t0)

A_iv_level.metric: error = arm IV - IV_cboe in vol points; per pair, per market and in total: n, median |error|, mean error, worst
A_iv_level.primary: D = |err smile_same| - |err vix_same| per pair; median D, its 95% bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of pairs, numpy default_rng(seed)), and the count of pairs where the smile is closer
A_iv_level.verdict: v1 pass bar on the pairs that have both arms

roll_weeks: none in 9-19 Nov 2026 (the December roll is 10 Dec)
not_tested: as v1, plus the one-session-late arms
